event.title: Runtime released claudecodeforpms
event.summary: Runtime is launching claudecodeforpms.com, a site where PMs can find and contribute best practices for shipping faster with Claude Code.

evidence.excerpt: We're launching claudecodeforpms.com, a site where PMs can find and contribute best practices for shipping faster with Claude Code. Christopher Lee was our first contributor. He wrote a PRD on managing secrets with coding agents, used Runtime to build it into the site, and merged the first PR in minutes. See how he did it here: https://lnkd.in/gDHg-QK7 If you have a Claude Code practice worth adding, comment below. We'll give you a month of free Runtime premium if you contribute to our repo…
